newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh leader to meet Yeltsin at Moscow sanatorium.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh leader to meet Yeltsin at Moscow sanatorium.

text.p: Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarabayev will fly to Moscow on Saturday to meet Russian leader Boris Yeltsin, Nazarbayev's press service said on Friday.
Nazarbayev would be the first foreign leader to meet Yeltsin since the Russian president underwent heart surgery earlier this month.
"The two leaders will meet at the Barvikha sanatorium," said spokesman Alexander Ivanov.
Earlier on Friday Yeltsin moved from the Central Clinical Hospital to Barvikha near Moscow to continue his convalescence from the November 5 quintuple bypass operation.
The two countries, along with Oman and several major oil companies, are due to sign a ground-breaking deal to pipe Kazakh oil through Russia on December 6.
Nazarbayev said recently he wanted to see ties strengthened between members of the Commonwealth of Independent States, founded five years ago this December.
